How fast-png.js was built (2026-10-24)
======================================

In an empty folder:

    npm install fast-png@8.0.0          (brings fflate 0.8.3, iobuffer 6.0.1)

entry.js:

    export { convertIndexedToRgb, decode, encode } from 'fast-png'

text-decoder-shim.js: the module below. The mod environment's TextDecoder
decodes UTF-8 only, and fast-png creates a "latin1" decoder when it loads
(for a PNG's optional text chunks), which made the module fail to load.

Build (esbuild 0.25.12):

    esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 \
      --inject:./text-decoder-shim.js --outfile=fast-png.bundle.js

Then prepend the header comment of fast-png.js. Licences: LICENSES.txt.

--- text-decoder-shim.js ---

const Base = globalThis.TextDecoder

const LATIN1 = /^(latin1|iso-8859-1|iso8859-1|l1|ascii|us-ascii|windows-1252)$/i

export class TextDecoder {
  constructor(label = 'utf-8', options) {
    this.isLatin1 = LATIN1.test(String(label).trim())
    this.inner = this.isLatin1 ? null : new Base(label, options)
  }

  get encoding() {
    return this.isLatin1 ? 'windows-1252' : this.inner.encoding
  }

  decode(input, options) {
    if (!this.isLatin1) return this.inner.decode(input, options)
    if (input === undefined) return ''
    const bytes = input instanceof Uint8Array
      ? input
      : ArrayBuffer.isView(input)
        ? new Uint8Array(input.buffer, input.byteOffset, input.byteLength)
        : new Uint8Array(input)
    let text = ''
    for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 4096) {
      text += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(index, index + 4096))
    }
    return text
  }
}
